name: std::chrono::tzdb_list
intro: tzdb_list is a singleton list of std::chrono::tzdbs, each of which represents a copy of the IANA time zone database. Users cannot construct a tzdb_list and can only obtain access to one via the std::chrono::get_tzdb_list free function.
